Build prompt

Rebuild this interaction 1:1: Airlearn's streak celebration screen - a big orange flame with the streak number "1" rises and settles while small ember particles detach from its tip and float upward, over a static headline and an "Add streak widget" card.

## Integration
Integration: stack-agnostic spec - springs given as stiffness/damping, timed motions as duration + curve; map every value to your framework and animation library of choice.

## Scene
Mobile screen, pale blue gradient top fading to white. Centered upper half: orange flame icon containing a white numeral "1". Below: "You've started your Spanish streak!" headline, "Keep this momentum up" subline, and a coral-outlined card ("Never miss your streak! / Add a widget on homescreen." with an orange "Add streak widget" button and a cactus mascot in a sombrero at its right edge).

## Motion spec
Pattern: looping ember particles over a settled hero icon.
- Entrance: flame scales up from 0.6 with a soft spring (~220/17, ~450ms) as the headline fades in.
- Embers: small orange dots (4-8px) spawn at the flame tip, drift upward 60-120px with slight horizontal wander, shrinking and fading out over ~1.2-1.8s; 1-2 new embers spawn every ~400ms, continuous loop.
- The flame itself gently pulses (scale 1 -> 1.03 -> 1, ~1.6s, ease-in-out).
- Headline, subline, and widget card stay static after entrance.

## Calibration
- Embers are the life of the shot - sparse (never more than ~5 alive) and slow; dense particles read as noise.
- Flame pulse is barely perceptible; do not bounce it.

## Reduced motion
Static flame and headline; no embers, no pulse.

## Don't miss
- Ember spawn point is the flame's top tip, not its center.
- The streak numeral is cut out of the flame (knockout), not overlaid text on top of a solid shape.
